eps.ov: Lufas visits Blutgang to retrieve Karkinos the Crab and Scorpius the Scorpion.
Dina and Megrez reveal how levelling works and the secret of the golden apples. Lufas greets Scorpius.
Lufas fights Scorpius & Dina frees her from the goddess. Aigokeros fights Luna, only for Terra to rescue her.
Terra removes Venus from the Seven Luminaries, ending Dina's spying. Lufas meets Mizar & upgrades her golems.

eps.t: The Hunting Festival Contestants Have Appeared!
eps.ov: Lufas visits Draupnir to take a break and let Virgo build confidence in the Hunting Festival.

eps.t: The Twelve Heavenly Star, Sagittarius Appeared!
eps.ov: Sei and Virgo brave a sacred mountain to get the Elixir for the beastfolk nation. The rest hunt Sagittarius.
Virgo & the heroes fight Mercurius, Aries helps them escape, then Lufas arrives to help Virgo finish the job.
Castor joins Sei & Virgo, fending off demihumans to save the guardian dragon. Lufas makes plans to face Leon.
Lufas meets with Benetnasch. Sei's party investigates the centaurs. The Twelve Heavenly Stars fight Leon.
